units.title: Introduction of iron making
topics: 1.1. Introduction of ferrous extractive metallurgy
1.2. Importance of iron as an engineering material
1.3. History of ancient Indian ironmaking
1.4. Modern ironmaking practices
1.5. Products of ironmaking: Wrought iron, and pig iron
uos: 1.a. Discuss briefly about importance of ferrous extraction process
1.b. Identify importance of iron in engineering field
1.c. Explain history and modern ironmaking practice
1.d. Discuss products of ironmaking

units.title: Raw
topics: 2.1. Raw materials use for Iron making: a. Iron ore – types, Valuation of ore b. Metallurgical coke – functions, Iron Making Course Code: 4342104 Unit Major Learning Outcomes Topics and Sub-topics materials of iron making and their issues
2.2. Issues of Indian’s raw materials
2.3. Beneficiation of iron ore – Crushing, screening and magnetic separation
2.4. Agglomeration processes – Sintering, Pelletization, Briquetting, Nodulizing
2.5. Testing methods for agglomerates
uos: 2.a. Explain raw materials use for iron making process
2.b. Describe beneficiation of iron ore
2.c. Describe agglomeration processes
2.d. Discuss about testing method for agglomerates properties c. Fluxes – importance and types d. Air

units.title: Blast Furnace process
topics: 3.1. Plant layout and constructional features of blast furnace (BF)
3.2. Temperature profile of BF
3.3. Physical and chemical properties of charging (or burden) materials
3.4. Charging systems of BF – Two bell and Bell-less top
3.5. Reactions involved in each zone of BF; Direct and indirect reduction; Concept of Tuyere Flame Temperature (TFT) and Raceway Adiabatic Flame Temperature (RAFT)
3.6. Desulpurization of hot metal
3.7. Characteristics of pig iron and slag, Basicity and V ratio of slag
3.8. Refractories used in BF
3.9. Modern trends of BF practice
uos: 3.a. Describe about sections of blast furnace (BF) plant and construction and temperature zone of BF
3.b. Explain characteristics of charging materials and charging systems
3.c. Understand about reactions involved in BF and concept of TFT and RAFT
3.d. Discuss desulpurization, pig iron, slag and refractories used in BF
3.e. Summarize modern trends of BF practice

units.title: Blast furnace auxiliaries and operations
topics: 4.1. Cleaning of BF gas – Dust catcher, Primary and secondary cleaning system
4.2. Hot blast stoves
4.3. Operations of BF and irregularities in operations
uos: 4.a. Explain cleaning mechanism for BF gas in detail
4.b. Discuss briefly hot blast stoves
4.c. Describe operations of BF and irregularities

units.title: Alternative methods of iron making
topics: 5.1. Alternative methods of Iron making - Needs, principle, advantages and limitations
5.2. Raw materials and their characteristics – iron ore, non- coking coal, natural gas, flux

5.3. Direct reduced iron or Sponge iron processes: Merits, demerits and types a. Coal based – Rotary kiln and Rotary hearth Iron Making Course Code: 4342104 Unit Major Learning Outcomes Topics and Sub-topics and mini-blast furnace b. Gas based – Midrex and HyL
5.4. Characteristics and use of sponge iron
5.5. Corex process and Mini-blast furnace
uos: 5.a. Discuss aspects of alternative methods of iron making
5.b. Explain raw materials, processes based on reducing agent and product of alternative methods
5.c. Describe Corex process

units.title: Sustainable developmen t in iron making plant
topics: 6.1. Pollution control – waste materials processing and utilization, CO2 emission, etc.
6.2. Energy conservation practices in plant
uos: 6.a. Discuss importance and actions required for pollution control in plant
6.b. Describe energy conservation at various stage of processes
